map.有效膜宽 = (膜宽 − 搭接量) ÷ 100 (m)；铺膜行数 = ⌊地块宽(: Effective film width = (film width - overlap) / 100 (m); film rows = floor(field width (cm) / row spacing (cm)); coverage rate = coverage area / field area x 100%; film weight = length x film width (m) x thickness (m) x density 0.92 g/cm3
map.铺膜行数按地块宽度除以行距向下取整，与「地宽 ÷ 有效膜宽」取较大值以满足最小铺: Film rows = floor(field width / row spacing), take the larger of that and "field width / effective film width" to meet minimum laying need; total film length = rows x field length. Coverage area = total length x effective width, divided by field area for coverage rate. Film weight uses PE density about 0.92 g/cm3 from length x width x thickness, for purchase quantity and cost.

map.地块 10 畦、每畦长 50 m、膜宽 0.9 m，理论覆盖 = 10×50×0: Field 10 beds, each 50 m long, film 0.9 m wide, theoretical cover = 10x50x0.9 = 450 m2 = 0.675 mu. Add 5% overlap loss, actual film about 0.71 mu equivalent (convert length by roll width).
map.宽膜减少接缝但边角浪费可能增。应按畦面宽选膜，使膜边入土压实即可，过宽反增成本与: Wide film cuts seams but may raise edge waste. Choose by bed width so edges tuck into soil; too wide raises cost and recovery difficulty.
